    • findArities

      public Map<String,Integer> findArities(Formula f)
      Returns:
      arities implied on every row var by their relations and arguments. if the pred var is only an argument to variable arity relations, return -1

    • expandRowVar

      public Set<Formula> expandRowVar(Formula f)
      Returns:
      a HashSet of FormulaAST. If just one row variable is an argument to a fixed arity relation, then there will be just one element in the returned set. But if there one or more row variables are arguments to VariableArityRelations then there will be multiple returned formulas

    • expandRowVar

      public Set<Formula> expandRowVar(Set<Formula> rowvars)

    • expandRowVarExpr

      public Set<Expr> expandRowVarExpr(Formula fa)
      Expr-based row-variable expansion. Mirrors expandRowVar(Formula) but operates on the structured Expr AST instead of the KIF string, avoiding all string-level find/replace operations.
      Parameters:
      fa - the FormulaAST whose expr field will be expanded
      Returns:
      set of expanded Expr trees (one per arity combination); returns a singleton containing fa.expr if no row vars found

    • spliceRowVar

      private Expr spliceRowVar(Expr expr, String rowVarName, List<Expr> vars, Formula fa, int n)
      Recursively splice vars in place of all occurrences of Expr.RowVar(rowVarName) in the Expr tree rooted at expr. When a substitution is made and the enclosing SExpr head is a VariableArityRelation (valence == -1), the head is renamed to pred_totalArity[Fn]. Does NOT mutate any RowStruct fields.

    • computeTotalArity

      private int computeTotalArity(String pred, String rowVarName, int n, Formula fa)
      Compute the total predicate arity after splicing n expanded row-var arguments into a VariableArityRelation. Mirrors the arithmetic in expandVariableArityRowVar(java.util.Set<com.articulate.sigma.Formula>, java.lang.String) and expandRowVar(Formula).
